# Rockery gate external references

Two of three required references are collected: slot 1, the Beijing reconstruction rockery, and slot 3, a dark moon gate with low fog. The Magic Blade cave corridor remains missing.

![Beijing rockery path](beijing-rockery-path.jpg)

**北京大观园 曲径通幽**, Sipa Photo image published by Beijing Tourism on 2021-02-25. [Primary article and attribution](https://www.visitbeijing.com.cn/article/47Qkj2HWV4x). The individual photographer and capture date are not supplied. The article credits 怡格格 for text and 邢爽 as editor; neither is identified as the photographer. Original bytes and the Sipa watermark are retained. This is copyrighted reference material, with no open licence asserted, and is not a shipped game asset.

The directly reviewed image shows the narrow dry paved path, irregular rock piles and overhangs, dark gaps, vines and pine branches. It supports the obstructed sightline and organic surface treatment. Daylight and the limited frame do not establish the full route, two bends, dimensions, plaster construction, fog or lantern lighting.

A second article image shows an overhang above a pool with lotus. It was reviewed but is not counted as another slot. The required *The Magic Blade* cave corridor remains missing; the fog/moon-gate reference was collected later, below.

## Dark-side moon gate with fog — 2026-10-09

![Dark moon gate, low fog and lantern path](dark-moon-gate-fog.jpeg)

**建发·天行泱著**, Ningde, Fujian. [Published image gallery](https://www.sohu.com/picture/342607749), [article and project credits](https://www.sohu.com/a/342607749_99928348), 2019-09-22, 住在宁德. The project credits landscape design to 深圳市赛瑞景观工程设计有限公司, lighting to 上海色点照明设计事务所, and photography to 王子路. [ARCHINA's project page](https://www.archina.com/index.php?a=show&g=works&id=3488&m=index) corroborates those credits; [Kinpan](https://www.kinpan.com/detail/index/6216233013887275) lists 王子路 and 万晓军 as project photographers. No source individually captions this frame. Copyright remains with the credited creators; no open licence is asserted. This is reference material outside shipped game assets.

The directly inspected original shows a dark circular gate surround, low cool fog across foreground water and planting, and four amber lanterns guiding the eye into the brighter opening. It fills slot 3's composition reference. The image does not identify a Shaw set or establish fog equipment, capture time, measured colors or light energy. The exact 1080×1558 JPEG is retained without edits. The contrasting gate, lamps and fog may guide the current neutral/amber palette; it does not accept the garden's final art.

[Source and download evidence](moon-gate-source-review/source-attribution.json) records the project-level credit limits and unsuccessful page/candidate fetches. Previous README/metadata bytes are retained in that folder.
